name: bare-cli-gate-gitroot-fallback
title: Resolve gitRoot for bare CLI gates (no --story) on wrapper-root projects
description: The bare lattice validate --concept (and the channel/lint CLI gates) run without a --story still fail on wrapper-root projects with Not a git repository. Confirmed root cause at packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:604: gitCwd is resolved via the story-scoped resolveGitCwd only when args.story is set; the no-story branch falls back to projectRoot (the metadataRoot, which is not a git repo on wrapper-root layouts). B-2856 fixed the --story / REVIEW-TEST preflight paths but not the standalone CLI command. Fix: for the no-story branch, resolve gitCwd via the already-exported project-level evaluateStoryDirConfigInsideGitRoot (id-independent, never throws), falling back to projectRoot when no gitRoot resolves. This is cwd-only and byte-identical for plain repos. Scope: just the no-story gitCwd fallback in verifier.ts; do not change gate pass/fail semantics or git command text.
